title: Unsupervised data-anomaly detection on price windows (Isolation Forest)
why: Label-free anomaly detection on incoming data is how production ML teams catch broken feeds before a model silently uses them.
notes: 122 real 28-day windows from 2025-11-01 to 2026-10-31 (every third day); thresholds from clean windows of 2019-01-01 to 2024-12-31 for about 5% false alarms: {k: round(v, 3) for k, v in res['threshold'].items()}.
Faults are injected into the latest day only: a spike (one hour times 8), a unit error (prices divided by 1000), a flat feed and a repeated day.
limits: Injected faults are synthetic; real feed failures can look different.
A window of 28 days is short; a repeated day is hard for any detector that only looks at daily statistics.
